description.value: Alta Bistro is a modern seasonal alpine cuisine restaurant in Whistler, established in 2010, built around locally sourced ingredients from suppliers such as North Arm Farm and Pemberton Valley producers. The menu showcases creative dishes including venison tartare with bone marrow dressing and hokkaido scallop carpaccio, making it a strong option for a celebratory post-ride dinner. The restaurant operates a transparent Employee Health Benefit program, collecting 2% of net sales before tax to support year-round staff wellness.
